title: Frobenius identities for the volume map on Cohen--Macaulay rings
summary: We study the volume map on Artinian quotients of Cohen-Macaulay algebras in characteristic $p$, and the interaction between it and the action of Frobenius on resolutions. This allows us to provide a general, conceptual way to understand Parseval-Rayleigh identities, curious inhomogeneous identities on the volume map which were developed for the proof of the Ohsugi-Hibi conjecture. This general perspective gives a new approach to generic Lefschetz theory.
